evidence_items.explanation: The report gives October adult AI-service usage as 44%, while Figure 2 shows 55% selecting never used. These results indicate both substantial engagement and widespread nonuse, but neither identifies nonusers as ignoring AI or verifies executives' personal Copilot trial.

unresolved_gaps: The located CNBC report does not establish respondents' personal Copilot trial rate; no questionnaire or respondent-level results resolving that distinction were located.
The executive sample supplies no demonstrated basis for estimating engagement among people generally.
Population usage surveys measure use, not whether nonusers are ignoring AI. Substantial use and widespread nonuse can coexist.
The claim does not specify which population or degree of disengagement its clear refutation addresses.
